title: Dario Amodei has just one direct report, his COS Avital Balwit; Anthropic's executive team reports to Daniela Amodei, who handles much of day-to-day operations (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Dario Amodei has just one direct report, his COS Avital Balwit; Anthropic's executive team reports to Daniela Amodei, who handles much of day-to-day operations — One of the most powerful AI chief executives has almost no direct reports at a moment when other tech leaders are widening their spans of control.
